inputs.ad_text_01: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. High angle shot over an economic researcher's large worktable. An East Asian female researcher starts with two selected architectural photo clippings, then pulls a wider stack of case files into view and lays them out in a complete grid. Other building photographs, calendars and printed data sheets are present. Show the sample expanding from selected anecdotes to many cases, no readable text.
